claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens.
In MDG, a segment of a document is masked, and the model predicts the original content of the masked segment.
MDG is one of the three tasks designed for pre-training sequence-to-sequence models, alongside Sentence Reordering and Next Sentence Generation.
